segments.name: Cannabis
segments.description: Produces, distributes and sells cannabis and cannabis-related products for medical patients and adult-use consumers in Canada and international markets.
segments.evidence: Cannabis - includes the global production, distribution and sale of a diverse range of cannabis and cannabis-related products.

segments.name: Storz & Bickel
segments.description: Produces, distributes and sells vaporizers and accessories, including medically approved herbal vaporizer devices, to medical and adult-use consumers worldwide.
segments.evidence: Storz & Bickel - includes the production, distribution and sale of vaporizers and accessories.

revenueModel.text: Provincial wholesalers, medical patients and adult-use consumers pay for cannabis products, while consumers and patients buy Storz & Bickel vaporizers and accessories.
revenueModel.evidence: For adult-use cannabis, we devote significant time to our relationship with provincial wholesalers to ensure that our products are present in retail stores and readily available for customers to purchase.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 the company changed the structure of its internal management reporting, replacing Canada cannabis, International markets cannabis, Storz & Bickel and This Works with Cannabis and Storz & Bickel.
changes.evidence: Following a change in our CODM (as defined below) and internal reorganizations initiated by us in the three months ended March 31, 2025, we changed the structure of our internal management reporting.

changes.text: The This Works segment was sold in December 2023 and its results left the reported segments.
changes.evidence: On December 18, 2023, the Company completed the sale of This Works and as of such date, the results of This Works are no longer included in the Company's financial results

changes.text: BioSteel was deconsolidated and its results classified as discontinued operations in fiscal 2024.
changes.evidence: For the year-end March 31, 2024, the Company deconsolidated BioSteel and classified its results as discontinued operations
